title: Yummy Crispy Greek Grape Leaves Dolmades
description: Citrusy and crispy, these Greek grape leaf dolmades are light, nut-free and perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Rinse grape leaves and blanch them for 2 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a bowl combine cooked rice, all purpose flour, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, ground cumin, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
Whisk in the egg until the mixture is smooth and well blended.
Place a heaped spoonful of the filling onto the center of each grape leaf, fold the sides over and roll tightly.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and brown the dolmades on all sides.
Add water to the skillet until it reaches about 1/4 inch from the bottom of the pan, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove the lid, raise the heat, and stir, allowing the liquid to evaporate for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, optionally drizzling any remaining lemony sauce over the top.
